items.raw_excerpt: Rayachoti is set for a ₹10.84 crore infrastructure upgrade, enhancing roads, drains, and water supply through multiple government grants.
items.summary_en: Rayachoti town will spend about 10.84 crore rupees on roads, drains, and water supply. Several government grants will pay for the improvements.

items.raw_excerpt: En Cooperativa, Eduardo Sáez descartó la ocurrencia de temporales intensos en los valles de la zona central. Asimismo, señaló que en sectores precordilleranos podrían caer chubascos aislados que "no va a generar barro".
items.summary_en: A meteorologist in Chile says no strong storms will hit the central valley. Small isolated showers may fall near the Andes foothills, but they will not make mud. That is good news for people planning outdoor barbecues during the national holiday.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 중부 계곡에는 강한 폭풍이 들이닥치지 않을 것이라고 한 기상 관계자가 밝혔다. 안데스 기슭 일부 지역에선 간헐적인 소나기가 내릴 수 있지만 진흙을 만들 정도는 아니라고 한다. 국경일 동안 야외 바비큐를 계획한 사람들에게 좋은 소식이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Bergen, Norway's second-largest city, isn't just known for its scenic beauty but also for its distinctive dialect and slang. For outsiders, these linguistic quirks can lead to challenges in day-to-day communication.
items.summary_en: Bergen is Norway's second-largest city. It has a very distinct dialect and slang. These everyday words can be hard for outsiders to understand.
items.summary_ko: 베르겐은 노르웨이에서 두 번째로 큰 도시입니다. 이 도시는 특별한 사투리와 속어로 유명합니다. 이런 일상 표현들은 외지인이 이해하기 어려울 수 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: El Museo Local de Nueva Carteya aclara que este tipo de representaciones eran normales en la época romana, aunque la longitud del relieve ha llamado la atenc...
items.summary_en: An archaeological dig in Córdoba found a large carved phallic relief. The Nueva Carteya local museum says such images were normal in Roman times. The unusual length of the relief caught people's attention.

items.title_en: Large Roman phallic carving found in Córdoba excavation

items.summary_en: Students and their families can get a close look at the latest technology and military equipment. The event aims to encourage young people to consider careers in defence and aerospace.

items.raw_excerpt: El Tribunal de Disciplina resolvió el caso presentado por la Gerencia de Ligas Profesionales debido a una situación relacionada con una entrevista del técnico "cruzado".
items.summary_en: Chile's disciplinary tribunal gave Universidad Catolica a warning. The case started after a complaint was filed about an interview by coach Garnero. The club will not get a bigger punishment.

items.raw_excerpt: Tributes to legendary singer M.S. Subbulakshmi on her 110th birthday celebrated with music and reverence in Tirupati.
items.summary_en: People in Tirupati honored legendary singer M.S. Subbulakshmi on her 110th birth anniversary. They held music events and paid tribute with deep respect.

items.raw_excerpt: As September unfolds, Lisbon's premier boulevard is undergoing a much-needed transformation.
items.summary_en: Lisbon is repairing Avenida da Liberdade, the city's most famous boulevard. Workers are resurfacing the roads and repainting crosswalks, mostly at night to avoid traffic. The city also plans new cycle lanes after the work is done.
items.summary_ko: 리스본에서 가장 유명한 대로인 아베니다 다 리베르다데가 보수 공사에 들어간다. 대부분 밤에 도로 포장을 새로 깔고 횡단보도를 다시 칠해 교통 불편을 최소화한다. 공사가 끝나면 자전거 도로도 새로 만들 예정이다.
items.title_en: Lisbon repairs its main boulevard Avenida da Liberdade
